article.title: PubMatic統籌Sugree國際採購，連接日本地面電視廣告
article.summary: Nippon TV委任PubMatic為Sugree的主要國際合作夥伴，集中處理海外買方對日本地面電視廣告的採購。
highlights: 海外廣告主可經PubMatic區域團隊處理帳戶接入、活動管理、報表及結帳。
Sugree在2025年推出，支援按曝光交易的程式化電視廣告。
article.why: 跨市場媒體團隊可把日本地面電視納入按曝光採購的規劃，並比較單一窗口是否能解決當地操作及結算需求。
article.next_step: 索取Sugree可買節目時段、曝光計價及報表欄位，與既有日本電視採購流程逐項比較。
article.detail: PubMatic表示，其北美、歐洲、中東非洲及亞太團隊會為國際買方提供語言和時區支援。這次公布的是國際合作角色擴展，Sugree平台已在較早階段推出。媒體團隊可先核對地面電視版位和既有串流影片採購在曝光定義、排期及報表上的差異，再判斷是否應使用同一預算比較。
article.title_en: PubMatic becomes Sugree's main international buying partner
article.summary_en: Nippon TV named PubMatic its primary international partner for Sugree, centralizing overseas access to Japanese terrestrial TV inventory.
highlights_en: Regional teams will handle onboarding, campaign management, reporting and billing.
Sugree launched in 2025 and supports impression-based programmatic TV transactions.
article.why_en: Cross-market media teams can assess Japanese broadcast TV within impression-based planning and compare the single contact with local operating needs.
article.next_step_en: Request bookable programming, impression pricing and reporting fields and compare them with current Japanese TV buying.
article.detail_en: PubMatic says teams in North America, EMEA and APAC provide language and time-zone support. The announcement expands its international role for an existing platform. Buyers can compare broadcast inventory with streaming video on impression definitions, scheduling and reporting before putting both into the same budget comparison.
